Gymnastics programs for Markham and Stouffville families.

Leap Gymnastics is a Gymnastics Ontario member club offering recreational gymnastics, advanced recreational and competitive pathways, camps, summer programs and gymnastics birthday parties.

About Leap Gymnastics

Leap Gymnastics is a dedicated gymnastics club in Markham, offering programs for athletes at different ages, abilities, and stages of development.

Located in Markham, Leap Gymnastics welcomes families from Markham, Stouffville, and nearby York Region communities.

Our coaching approach focuses on safe skill development, proper technique, age-appropriate instruction, and athlete readiness. Gymnasts build strength, flexibility, coordination, balance, body control, spatial awareness, focus, and confidence through structured gymnastics training led by NCCP-trained coaches.

For school-age recreational gymnasts, Leap follows the CANGYM skill-development pathway where applicable. CANGYM supports progress through recognized skill levels and helps gymnasts, coaches, and families track development over time.

Gymnastics is one of the strongest foundations for physical literacy. The skills athletes develop in gymnastics support movement, confidence, and performance in the gym, in other sports, and in everyday activity.

Our Programs
RECREATIONAL GYMNASTICS
Leap offers progressive weekly gymnastics classes for parent-and-tot, preschool and school-age gymnasts, including boys-focused and floor and tumbling programs. Coaches adapt instruction to each gymnast’s age, ability and readiness.

Classes run from September to June, and children may join an available class at any point during the year. Enrolment is month-to-month, with no full-year commitment.
View Classes
ADVANCED RECREATIONAL PROGRAMS
Leap Plus classes are longer-format recreational programs for gymnasts who are ready for more training time, more repetitions, stronger conditioning, and a faster class pace. These programs are designed for athletes who want to continue progressing in a structured recreational environment.
See programs
COMPETITIVE GYMNASTICS
Leap offers a competitive gymnastics pathway for athletes who are ready for a more focused training environment. Entry into the competitive program is by coach assessment. Placement is based on ability, readiness, commitment, training goals, and appropriate program fit.
See programs
CAMPS AND SUMMER PROGRAMS
Leap offers P.A. Day camps, March Break camps, summer camps and weekly summer gymnastics classes.
See camps
BIRTHDAY PARTIES
Leap offers weekend gymnastics birthday parties in a dedicated gymnastics facility. Birthday parties are separate from Leap’s gymnastics programs and are designed as supervised in-gym celebrations led by Leap staff.
See parties
Why Choose Leap
GYMNASTICS ONTARIO MEMBER CLUB
Leap is a Gymnastics Ontario member club and operates within Ontario’s provincial gymnastics system.
 
NCCP-TRAINED COACHES
Leap’s coaches are trained through the National Coaching Certification Program and provide instruction based on safe progressions, proper technique, and athlete readiness.
 
CANGYM SKILL DEVELOPMENT
School-age recreational gymnasts follow the CANGYM skill-development pathway where applicable, supporting structured progress and skill recognition.
 
STRUCTURED COACHING
Classes are built around proper progressions, safe technique, repetition, correction, and athlete readiness.
 
SMALL CLASS RATIOS
Classes are capped at 8 gymnasts per coach, allowing for more individual instruction, supervision, and feedback.
 
DEDICATED GYMNASTICS FACILITY
Gymnasts train in a dedicated facility with gymnastics apparatus and training equipment appropriate to their age, level, and program.
 
SAFE SPORT ENVIRONMENT
Leap is committed to a safe, respectful, and professional sport environment for gymnasts, coaches, and families.
 
Find the Right Program

Not sure where to start? Leap can help you choose the right class based on your child’s age, experience, and goals.

Recreational Programs

Leap’s recreational programs provide structured weekly gymnastics instruction for children at every stage, from their first parent-and-tot class through advanced recreational training.

As a Gymnastics Ontario member club, Leap uses age-, ability- and readiness-appropriate progressions to support safe and consistent skill development. Depending on the program, gymnasts develop skills across vault, bars, beam and floor while building strength, flexibility, balance, coordination, spatial awareness and confidence.

Children progress from their current ability level rather than following a curriculum that begins each September. This allows new gymnasts to join during the year while existing gymnasts continue working toward increasingly challenging skills.

Recreational classes operate from September to June, and children may join in any month where space is available. Enrolment is month-to-month, with no requirement to commit to the full school year.

Once registered, your child remains in the same weekly class and continues to be enrolled until you choose to withdraw. Families do not need to register again each month.

Withdrawal requires 15 days’ written notice. Please review our Cancellation and Refund Policy for complete billing, withdrawal and refund details.

Recreational Program Information
$95/month while enrolled

Weekly Recreational Gymnastics

One one-hour coached class each week
Same weekly class day and time while enrolled
Progressive instruction based on each gymnast’s ability and readiness
Maximum 1:8 coach-to-gymnast ratio unless otherwise stated
Join throughout the year where space is available

Month-to-month enrolment with no full-year commitment.

Gymnastics Ontario Participant Registration

Leap Gymnastics is a member club of Gymnastics Ontario. Participants in the September-to-June recreational classes listed on this page are registered with Gymnastics Ontario in accordance with its participant registration requirements.

A $50 annual participant registration fee is charged separately from program tuition and is added at checkout when applicable. It is charged once per participant during the Gymnastics Ontario membership year, which runs from July 1 to June 30, regardless of how many applicable Leap programs the participant registers for during that membership year.

The registration includes applicable sport accident insurance coverage while participating in Gymnastics Ontario-sanctioned activities. Once processed, the registration fee is non-refundable.

Leap Together Parent & Tot
Ages 18 months to 3 years 1 hour

A coach-led introduction to gymnastics for young children, with a parent or caregiver participating alongside them.

Children begin developing fundamental gymnastics movement through structured stations that introduce climbing, hanging, balancing, jumping, rolling, supported body positions and safe landings. Coaches guide both the child and caregiver while gradually building body awareness, coordination and confidence moving through a gymnastics environment.

Leap Together gives young children an age-appropriate foundation for future independent gymnastics classes.

Little Leapers (Age 3)
Age 3 1 hour

An independent preschool gymnastics program designed specifically for three-year-olds who are ready to participate in class without a parent or caregiver.

Gymnasts are introduced to fundamental gymnastics positions and skills through structured, coach-led stations. Training develops jumping and landing mechanics, rolls, balances, hangs and supports, basic body shapes, coordination and spatial awareness using age-appropriate gymnastics equipment.

The focus is on building strong early gymnastics foundations while developing the listening, independence and body control needed to progress into more advanced preschool gymnastics.

Coaches adapt skills to each gymnast's ability and readiness, helping athletes develop proper technique, strength, flexibility, coordination and body control while preparing for continued recreational gymnastics development.

Rising Stars is designed to give gymnasts a strong technical foundation while allowing each athlete to progress at an appropriate pace.

Floor Tumbling & Obstacle Skills
Recommended 7+ | 1 hour

A floor-focused recreational gymnastics program for athletes who want more time to develop their gymnastics skills on the floor.

Gymnasts work through structured progressions that develop the foundations needed for strong floor skills, including body positions and control, handstands, rolls, cartwheels, jumping and landing technique, strength, flexibility and coordination. As athletes build the necessary technique and physical readiness, they progress toward increasingly challenging floor and tumbling skills.

Unlike our regular recreational gymnastics programs, this class does not rotate through vault, bars and beam. Training time is dedicated to floor skill development, with obstacle stations and conditioning incorporated to develop the strength, power, agility, spatial awareness and movement control that support gymnastics progression.

No previous gymnastics experience is required. Athletes work at their own level and progress according to their ability and readiness.

Flight Crew gives older athletes the opportunity to learn and progress in gymnastics at their own level without needing previous competitive experience.

Leap Plus is Leap’s advanced recreational pathway for gymnasts who are ready for longer training sessions and more time for repetitions, conditioning, skill development and progression. These structured 90-minute weekly classes provide additional training time while remaining within Leap’s recreational program.

Leap Plus classes operate weekly from September to June. Eligible gymnasts may join during the year where an appropriate class and space are available. Enrolment is month-to-month, with no full-year commitment.

LEAP camp days give children a full day of movement, creativity, and supervised activity in a gymnastics setting.

Campers spend time on the gym floor participating in coached gymnastics activities, games, obstacle courses, crafts, and active play. Each day includes a balance of structured movement, group activities, creative time, and scheduled snack and lunch breaks.

Camp programming is designed for children ages 4 to 12. Activities are planned with age, readiness, and safety in mind, and campers are grouped and supervised by coaches throughout the day.

LEAP offers camp days during school breaks and select school closure days, including Summer Camp, PA Day Camp, and March Break Camp when available.

Try Leap drop-ins are structured, coach-led recreational gymnastics classes for new families who would like to experience Leap before registering for a regular weekly program. Sessions are offered for different age groups at selected times throughout the year.

Participants receive coached instruction in age-appropriate foundational gymnastics skills, using equipment and progressions suited to their age, experience, and readiness.

How Drop-Ins Differ From Regular Programs

Each drop-in is a structured recreational gymnastics class. However, drop-ins are standalone sessions and do not provide the continuous age-based curriculum, regular attendance, consistent coaching or class-to-class skill progression of Leap’s weekly recreational programs.

Regular recreational programs operate from September to June with month-to-month enrolment. Children may join during any month where space is available.

Families who would like ongoing weekly gymnastics instruction and progressive skill development can register for a regular Leap program. To maintain the structure of those classes, Leap does not place trial participants within regularly scheduled programs. Instead, new families can book a Try Leap drop-in session.

Attendance and Gymnastics Ontario Registration

Families may book more than one available drop-in session while deciding whether a regular Leap program is the right fit for their child.

If a child attends Leap Gymnastics for more than three visits during the Gymnastics Ontario membership year, including through drop-ins, camps, classes, or other Leap activities, Leap will contact the family and charge the $50 annual Gymnastics Ontario participant registration fee.

The Gymnastics Ontario membership year runs from July 1 to June 30. The fee is charged once per participant during that period and is separate from drop-in fees.

LEAP Gymnastics began with two friends, two daughters, and a shared love for a sport that had stayed with them since childhood.

Long before LEAP had a name, gymnastics was part of our own early lives. It was the place where we learned to be brave, to try again, to trust our bodies, and to feel proud of small improvements. Some days were about learning a new skill. Other days were about falling, getting back up, and discovering that progress does not always happen all at once.

Years later, we found ourselves watching our daughters grow into the same kind of children we once were: active, curious, determined, and happiest when they were moving. Our daughters became friends too, and gymnastics became part of their childhood in a new way.

As parents, we started to imagine a space where children could experience gymnastics with the same sense of excitement and confidence we remembered, but in a setting designed for today’s families. We wanted a club that felt organized, welcoming, and thoughtful from the moment families walked in. A place where children could build real gymnastics foundations, learn through proper progressions, and be supported by coaches who understand that every child develops at their own pace.

That idea slowly became LEAP.

We built LEAP Gymnastics in Markham as a place for children from Markham, Stouffville, and nearby communities to move, learn, and grow. Our programs are designed for different ages, abilities, and stages of development, from first classes and recreational gymnastics to advanced recreational training, competitive pathways, camps, summer programs, birthday parties, and drop-in opportunities.

At LEAP, gymnastics is not only about skills. It is about strength, coordination, balance, flexibility, focus, confidence, and the joy of discovering what your body can do. It is about learning how to listen, try, practise, and keep going.

Our coaching approach is grounded in safe technique, proper progressions, athlete readiness, and age-appropriate instruction. We want every child to feel supported, challenged, and proud of their progress, whether they are stepping into the gym for the first time or working toward a more focused training pathway.

LEAP was created with care because this sport meant something to us as children, and now it means something to our daughters.

We are proud to share that experience with families across Markham and York Region, and to welcome each child into a space where they can take their next leap with confidence.
